post_title: What will be the closing level of South Korea's KOSPI index on October 29, 2026?

question.title: What will be the closing level of South Korea's KOSPI index on October 29, 2026?
question.description:
The KOSPI (Korea Composite Stock Price Index) is the benchmark stock index of the Korea Exchange, capturing all common shares traded on its main board. It is heavily weighted toward semiconductor giants Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, which makes it highly sensitive to global sentiment around AI and chip demand.

After a strong 2026 rally that carried the index above 7,000, the KOSPI saw sharp swings in October 2026. It closed at 7,003.74 on Oct 2, 2026, then fell steadily: 6,625.93 (Oct 8), 6,384.24 (Oct 12), 6,035.35 (Oct 13), and 6,008.81 (Oct 14). On Oct 15, 2026 it plunged 6.2% to close at 5,554.22 — triggering its first circuit breaker in about 2.5 months amid a global AI-driven semiconductor sell-off. It rebounded 1.8% the next day to close at 5,655.34 on Oct 16, 2026. Over roughly the prior month the index was down about 14%.

This recent volatility — with daily moves of several percent in both directions and the index trading in a wide band from the mid-5,000s to around 7,000 within a single month — makes the closing level on any specific future date highly uncertain. Samsung Electronics had reported record earnings in early October, while concerns about an AI bubble, the end of share buybacks, and options expiration have driven the recent declines.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the closing level of the KOSPI Composite Index (^KS11) on October 29, 2026, as reported on the [Yahoo Finance historical data page](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/%5EKS11/history/) in the "Close" column for the row dated Oct 29, 2026. For example, a close of 5,655.34 resolves as 5655.34. If October 29, 2026 is not a trading day on the Korea Exchange (e.g. due to an unscheduled closure), the question resolves as the close on the most recent prior trading day shown. If Yahoo Finance does not report the value, the closing level reported by [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) such as Investing.com or the Korea Exchange will be used.
question.fine_print: The index level refers to the standard KOSPI Composite Index (Korea Composite Stock Price Index), denominated in index points, not adjusted for dividends.
